meteo.name: meteo
notes: SINGLE STATION (GIKOMERO). Meteorological predictors vary in time but NOT in space. Any apparent spatial skill comes from SAR/optical/terrain, not from weather.
168 independent wet spells (>=1 mm runs) across 979 daily rows. Effective meteorological sample size ~= 168, not 979.
Humidity complete on 259/979 days (26.5%). Incomplete days differ by +12.8 pts -> NOT missing at random. Gate on the flag; never impute across it.
5 days report exactly 0.0% RH (implausible) -> treat as missing.

sentinel1.name: sentinel1
notes: 4 buffer radii present [np.int64(10), np.int64(50), np.int64(100), np.int64(250)]: 512959 rows describe about 127800 site-dates. The loader pivots radii into columns; it does NOT collapse them, so the multi-scale design is preserved.
2 relative orbits present [21.0, 123.0]. Tracks with different incidence angles carry a systematic backscatter offset, so rel_orbit is retained as a model feature.
1759 rows share (site, date, buffer, orbit) -- two tracks imaging the same day. These are genuine repeat looks and are averaged in LINEAR POWER by the loader, not discarded.
